queries:
SELECT
    SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS average_rate_difference
FROM fees
WHERE rebrate > 0.0005

SELECT
  SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate,
  AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS average_rate_difference
FROM fees
WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005

SELECT
    SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebates,
    AVG(feerate) AS average_fee_rate
FROM fees
WHERE rebrate > 0.0005
  AND rebtotal IS NOT NULL
  AND feerate IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebates,
  AVG(feerate) AS average_fee_rate
FROM fees
WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005
  AND rebtotal IS NOT NULL
  AND feerate IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate,
  AVG(feerate) - AVG(rebrate) AS average_net_fee_rate
FROM fees
WHERE rebrate > 0.0005

SELECT
  SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate,
  AVG(feerate) - AVG(rebrate) AS average_net_fee_rate
FROM fees
WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005
